proposed_decision.rule: Govern AN as a first-person speaker/self referent and EN as a second-person addressee referent for already-scoped beginner/attested use. Preserve AUTH-016 and AUTH-017 as CANDIDATE/CLOSED_LIST_ONLY mappings. Do not promote AN/EN into a complete pronoun paradigm or assign general syntactic case/subject/possessive behavior.
proposed_decision.rationale: Repeated phrase distribution plus existing governed mappings supports narrow person-reference roles, but the corpus is insufficient for a full person/number, case, possessive or agreement system.

governance_decisions.proposal: Do not define AN or EN as universally obligatory grammatical subjects; subject grammar remains unresolved.
Do not infer EN=possessive 'your' from the approximate translation of PHR-001; possessive structure remains unresolved.
Do not create object case, possessive case, plural, gender, politeness, clusivity, agreement or pro-drop rules under B14.
Do not widen AN/EN beyond their scoped mappings or change their CANDIDATE authority/productivity status.
B14 changes no general clause order, interrogative architecture, tense/modal grammar, other lexical authority, productivity or curriculum slots.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-B14-001 through DEC-B14-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not approve B15, create possessive/subject grammar, or generalize AN/EN beyond the scoped person-reference pair.
